title: Chapter 78
text:
When infiltrating a base, the more nervous one was, the easier it was to be exposed. Han Xiao had experience in infiltration. He was calm and collected, and he did not attract any attention.

After wandering around the base for a while, he gradually understood the structure of the base. The base was hidden in the middle of the mountain. It was not small, at least five or six times larger than the laboratory that he had stayed in before. There were two exits. One was the main entrance, and the other was a side door that was directly connected to the outside world. It was convenient for personnel to enter and leave alone.

For some reason, Han Xiao felt that something was wrong in the base, but he could not pinpoint what was wrong.

Most of the people had a serious expression on their faces as they hurriedly moved the important supplies.

"Have you heard? The higher-ups want us to evacuate. It seems that the Hesla people have discovered us."

"The higher-ups said that the scouts in Crow Forest Town have lost contact. It seems that a war is about to break out."

After turning a corner, Han Xiao heard voices. A few armed guards were gathered together and talking. They sounded worried. When they saw Han Xiao, one of them shouted, "Hey, Talamander, did you guys find anything when you went out to search?"

Talamander was the real name of H223. He was a Caucasian. Han Xiao wrapped himself tightly in his uniform, so his skin color could not be seen.

These few guards seemed to know Talamander. Han Xiao's eyes flashed. "The sentry posts outside were shot in the head by a sniper rifle. There was no enemy. I guess this is the work of the Hesla people," he said.

The guards were worried. They were armed personnel. If the enemy attacked, they would have to stop them.

"I'm so envious of the civilian staff. They can evacuate first," one of the guards said angrily.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. The evacuation of the Dark Crow Valley base was expected. After all, they were facing the official army of Hesla, and this was only a sub-base. It was impossible for all of them to stay and fight to the death. However, it was not an easy task to evacuate. With so many people, they would leave traces in the forest and be tracked by the Hesla army. Therefore, some of the armed personnel had to stay behind to fight the enemy. The officers and civilian staff had to evacuate first with the important supplies. Some confidential supplies were more important than people. The remaining armed personnel would only receive the order to evacuate when the officers were out of danger.

The ultimate goal of the faction mission was to destroy the Dark Crow Valley Base. That included the enemy's forces. If they were to only occupy an empty base, the mission completion rate would be very low.

Han Xiao suddenly realized a problem. "Why didn't the base evacuate when they knew about Hesla's invasion? Ye Fan invaded last night and it's been 24 hours. It should be enough time for them to retreat … Something's wrong. "

At this time, a burly man walked over and shouted, "What are you all doing? Don't you have anything to do? Go and carry the things!"

The few guards hurriedly apologized in fear and trepidation. Han Xiao's eyes lit up. This officer was the base's guard captain, Duo Meng, a tall and sturdy Sharnuk.

What secrets did the base hold? Such a core figure would definitely know.

After Duo Meng berated him a few times, he turned around and left. Han Xiao followed him from a distance. After turning a few corners, he was suddenly stunned. Duo Meng had actually disappeared. He had only left his line of sight for two seconds.

There was no one in this corridor except for a utility room.

Han Xiao walked over and twisted the doorknob. There was no lock on the door.

He pushed the door open and walked in. There was no one inside, only a pile of miscellaneous items. The lights were not turned on, and the light from the corridor outside shone in through the gap of the door.

Han Xiao suddenly frowned as he realized something was wrong.

The utility room was spotless, and there were no footprints on the floor.

Logically speaking, very few people would be in the utility room. Even five-star hotels were too lazy to organize cleaners every day, so it was even more impossible for the Germinal Organization to do so.

Han Xiao was sure that there was a secret door here. Otherwise, Duo Meng would not have disappeared into thin air. However, he could not find the location of the secret door.

What would be behind the secret door?

Suddenly, Han Xiao covered his mouth and coughed. While he was bending down, he took out the only Spider Detector he had on him and threw it to the corner of the storage room. Then, he quickly left the storage room and found a blind spot where there were no surveillance cameras. He took out his tablet and activated the Spider Detector to keep an eye on the storage room.

This lasted for two hours, which was far beyond Han Xiao's estimation. He was extremely tense and felt a little tired.

At this time, there was finally a change in the utility room.

A metal door cracked open on one side of the wall, and two people walked out. They were not armed and seemed to be technicians.

"It is indeed a secret door."

The two of them hurriedly left the utility room. Han Xiao quietly followed them. His eyes turned, and he quickened his pace. He bumped into the two from behind, and the three of them staggered.

"Sorry, sorry, sorry." Han Xiao hurriedly apologized and helped the two of them up.

The two of them did not say anything.

Han Xiao continued to follow the two of them. At this time, he had a white card in his hand. It was the ID card that one of them had put in his shirt pocket.

Learn how to steal and travel the world.

The card was exactly the same as a normal ID card, but Han Xiao felt that the chip inside was different. It had the authority to pass through the secret door.

He followed the two of them all the way to the side door of the base. The two of them greeted the guards at the door and walked out.

Han Xiao suddenly had a flash of inspiration. He finally knew what was wrong with this base.

The atmosphere!

Most of the people were nervous and worried that the Hesla army would launch a large-scale attack. However, a small number of people stayed at their posts and were not worried at all. It was as if they had something to rely on, which was different from the nervous people.

If one did not pay close attention, it would be difficult to notice a small number of the latter.

The two of them who had walked out of the secret door just now had a look of confidence.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He had a guess, but he still needed to verify it. When he came to the side door, the guard stopped him.

"You are not allowed to enter or leave the base without a mission."

Han Xiao took out the stolen ID card and said, "I bumped into the two of them just now, and they dropped this ID card. I will give it to them before they go too far."

The guard nodded and let him go.

Han Xiao walked out of the side door. Outside the base was a forest valley. It was already early in the morning. The two of them were only a few hundred meters away, and he could only see their small backs. He quickly chased after them.

The two of them heard footsteps behind them and turned around. They were alert.

"You dropped your ID cards."

When Han Xiao came closer, the two of them realized that Han Xiao was a colleague they had met in the base. They were relieved. The one who had dropped his ID card touched his pocket and said in surprise, "When did you drop it? Thank you. "

"What are you thanking me for? We are all revolutionary comrades who are working together to build a spiritual civilization. This is what I should do."

Han Xiao walked closer with a smile.

"You are such an interesting person."

One of them smiled. Just as he was about to reach out and take the ID card, Han Xiao's expression suddenly froze. He suddenly attacked and landed a heavy punch on the opponent's stomach. The force went through the opponent's flesh and shook the opponent's guts. The opponent's eyes widened, and he spat out a mouthful of bile. Before the other person could even scream, Han Xiao had already grabbed his neck with one hand, strangling his windpipe, and smashing his head onto the ground. Then, he slammed his palm into the ground and knocked the two ordinary people unconscious.

Han Xiao took out his belt and tied the two of them together. He dragged them behind him and walked in a big circle to avoid the possible sentries. When he was far enough away from the base, he slapped the two of them to wake them up.

The two of them woke up and said in horror, "You … You are not from the base!"

Han Xiao unsheathed his Retractable Machete and stroked the blade with his fingers. "I know you guys have some information that normal members don't know. Please tell me honestly," he said coldly.

The two of them gulped and said, "We low-level members don't know anything."

"Low-level members?" Han Xiao laughed. He suddenly stabbed the knife and went straight for the lower part of one of them.

"Ah!"

The man was so scared that his soul almost left his body. He screamed like a pig being slaughtered. Suddenly, he realized that he didn't feel any pain. He lowered his head and saw the shiny blade rubbing against his inner thigh and stabbing into the soil. It was only three centimeters away from his little brother. The cold metal clearly transmitted to his crotch.

"I know that there is a secret door in the storage room. Tell me everything you know, or I will make you the first eunuch of the Germinal Organization." Han Xiao's tone was murderous.

Although the two of them did not know what eunuch meant, Han Xiao's actions showed what he was going to do. The two of them were shocked.

"You … How do you know about the secret door?"

"I am the one asking the questions." Han Xiao raised his knife and slid the blade against the other person's private part. It was as if he was going to cut down at any time. The other person was so scared that he peed … F * ck, he really peed. My knife!

The two of them were dejected. Since the secret had been found out, there was no point in hiding it. They told him the secret while trembling.

Ten minutes later.

Han Xiao frowned.

"So that's how it is …"
